default_row_limit.label: Default row limit
default_row_limit.help: The most rows a query returns when the caller sets no limit of its own.

engine_query_timeout.label: Engine query timeout
engine_query_timeout.help: How long the federation engine may run one query before it is cancelled.

retry_budget_secs.label: Retry budget
retry_budget_secs.help: How long a failed query keeps being retried before the error is returned; 0 turns retries off.

request_timeout.label: Default request timeout
request_timeout.help: How long a request may run before it is cancelled, for any transport without a value of its own.

request_timeouts.label: Request timeout per transport
request_timeouts.help: The request time limit for each transport on its own; a transport left empty uses the default. Flight ships at 3600 seconds and pgwire at 300.

max_query_complexity.label: Max query complexity
max_query_complexity.help: The highest complexity score one statement may have, for every role. A role may set a lower limit of its own. Leave unset for no limit.

default_sample_size.label: Default sample size
default_sample_size.help: How many rows a sampled query reads when the caller does not say.

auto_track_fk.label: Auto-track foreign keys
auto_track_fk.help: Whether registering a table also registers its foreign keys as relationships.

max_message_bytes.label: gRPC maximum message size
max_message_bytes.help: The largest single gRPC message the server sends or accepts; restart required because it is a server option set when the gRPC server is built.

allow_unsecured_reflection.label: Allow unsecured gRPC reflection
allow_unsecured_reflection.help: Lets gRPC clients list the services of a deployment that has no authentication. Restart required; guarded because it exposes the service surface.

recv_timeout.label: Bolt receive timeout
recv_timeout.help: The hint a Bolt (Neo4j) client is given for how long to wait for a reply.

allowed_origins.label: Bolt allowed origins
allowed_origins.help: The web sites allowed to open a Bolt connection from a browser; none are allowed until listed. Guarded because each entry lets that site drive the port.

ready_timeout.label: Engine ready timeout
ready_timeout.help: How long startup waits for the federation engine to become ready before failing.

jvm_heap_gb.label: Engine JVM heap (GB)
jvm_heap_gb.help: The memory given to the federation engine's Java process. Takes effect when the engine restarts.

query_max_memory.label: Query memory limit
query_max_memory.help: The most memory one query may use across the engine cluster. Takes effect when the engine restarts.

query_max_memory_per_node.label: Query memory limit per node
query_max_memory_per_node.help: The most memory one query may use on a single engine node. Takes effect when the engine restarts.

query_max_total_memory.label: Query total memory limit
query_max_total_memory.help: The most memory one query may use in total, including system memory. Takes effect when the engine restarts.

fault_tolerant_execution.label: Fault-tolerant execution
fault_tolerant_execution.help: Whether the engine retries failed parts of a query instead of failing the whole query. Takes effect when the engine restarts.

fault_tolerant_task_memory.label: Fault-tolerant task memory
fault_tolerant_task_memory.help: The memory reserved per task when fault-tolerant execution is on. Takes effect when the engine restarts.

exchange_spool_dir.label: Exchange spool folder
exchange_spool_dir.help: Where the engine keeps intermediate data for fault-tolerant execution. Takes effect when the engine restarts.

proxy_timeout.label: UI proxy timeout
proxy_timeout.help: How long the UI server waits for the API to answer a proxied request before reporting a timeout; it must outlast an engine wake.

background_workers.label: Background workers
background_workers.help: The number of threads each worker process uses for background work; restart required because the pool is sized once at start.

grpc_max_concurrent_rpcs.label: gRPC concurrent calls
grpc_max_concurrent_rpcs.help: The most gRPC calls one worker process serves at once; more are refused. Restart required because it sizes the gRPC server's thread pool.

flight_max_concurrent_streams.label: Arrow Flight concurrent streams
flight_max_concurrent_streams.help: The most Arrow Flight streams one worker process runs at once; more wait for a slot. Restart required because the slots are created at start.

request_threads.label: Request threads per worker
request_threads.help: The most requests one worker process runs at once; more wait for a free thread. Restart required because the limit is fixed when the worker starts.

workers.label: Worker processes
workers.help: How many worker processes the server runs. Restart required because processes are started by the launcher.

builds_per_node.label: Replica builds per node
builds_per_node.help: The most replica builds one host runs at once. Add nodes to build more replicas at the same time. A source's live-read cap also limits builds; with the embedded Redis that cap is counted per process, not across nodes.

engine_jobs.label: Background jobs per engine
engine_jobs.help: The most background jobs (replica builds) running on one engine at once, across every node. Requests are not counted.

retry_interval.label: Replica build retry interval
retry_interval.help: After a replica build fails, a read does not ask for another build until this long has passed.

spool_max_bytes.label: Replica spool disk limit
spool_max_bytes.help: The most disk space this node uses to hold a source's answer in a temporary file while its replica is built. It applies to sources that answer with one document and cannot be read through a cursor. A build that would pass the limit fails; nothing is truncated.

mode.label: Security mode
mode.help: Standard, or high security, where data endpoints refuse any client that cannot decrypt results itself and the pgwire, Bolt and MCP listeners are not started. Restart required because it decides which listeners start; guarded because it cuts off ordinary clients.

multitenancy.label: Multitenancy
multitenancy.help: Whether the deployment serves several organizations, each administering only its own data. Restart required because role grants are set at start; guarded because it changes who may administer the deployment.

username.label: Break-glass account name
username.help: The name of the break-glass account that can always sign in. Restart required; guarded.

password.label: Break-glass account password
password.help: The break-glass account's password. Secret; restart required; guarded.

require_tls.label: Require TLS for Redis
require_tls.help: Refuses to start on a Redis address that does not use TLS. Restart required because it is checked when the cache connects.

max_attempts.label: Sign-in attempts before lockout
max_attempts.help: How many failed sign-ins within the window lock an account out. Guarded because raising it weakens the brake on password guessing.

window_seconds.label: Sign-in attempt window
window_seconds.help: How far back failed sign-ins are counted. Guarded because shortening it weakens the brake on password guessing.

lockout_seconds.label: Lockout duration
lockout_seconds.help: How long a locked-out account is refused. Guarded because shortening it weakens the brake on password guessing.

hostname.label: Host name
hostname.help: The host name the deployment advertises to clients in the addresses it hands out. Restart required because servers started at boot carry it.

grpc_port.label: gRPC port
grpc_port.help: The port the gRPC server listens on. Restart required; guarded because clients and firewalls must follow a change.

flight_port.label: Arrow Flight port
flight_port.help: The port the Arrow Flight server listens on. Restart required; guarded because clients and firewalls must follow a change.

flight_compression.label: Arrow Flight compression
flight_compression.help: How the record batches Arrow Flight sends are compressed: none, lz4 or zstd. Clients need no setting; applies to streams opened after the change.

pgwire_port.label: PostgreSQL wire port
pgwire_port.help: The port the PostgreSQL-protocol server listens on; 0 leaves it off. Restart required; guarded because it opens or closes a listener.

bolt_port.label: Bolt port
bolt_port.help: The port the Bolt (Neo4j) server listens on; 0 leaves it off. Restart required; guarded because it opens or closes a listener.

airport_port.label: Airport port
airport_port.help: The port the Airport Flight service listens on; 0 leaves it off. Restart required; guarded because it opens or closes a listener.

port.label: HTTP API port
port.help: The port the HTTP API listens on. Restart required; guarded because the UI and every client must follow a change.

cert.label: TLS certificate
cert.help: The path of the certificate file every protocol listener presents, unless a protocol names its own. Restart required; guarded because a wrong file stops TLS listeners starting.

key.label: TLS private key
key.help: The path of the private key that goes with the certificate. Restart required; guarded because a wrong file stops TLS listeners starting.

grpc_cert.label: gRPC TLS certificate
grpc_cert.help: A certificate file for the gRPC listener alone, instead of the shared one. Restart required; guarded.

grpc_key.label: gRPC TLS private key
grpc_key.help: The private key for the gRPC listener's own certificate. Restart required; guarded.

flight_cert.label: Arrow Flight TLS certificate
flight_cert.help: A certificate file for the Arrow Flight listener alone, instead of the shared one. Restart required; guarded.

flight_key.label: Arrow Flight TLS private key
flight_key.help: The private key for the Arrow Flight listener's own certificate. Restart required; guarded.

pgwire_cert.label: PostgreSQL wire TLS certificate
pgwire_cert.help: A certificate file for the PostgreSQL-protocol listener alone, instead of the shared one. Restart required; guarded.

pgwire_key.label: PostgreSQL wire TLS private key
pgwire_key.help: The private key for the PostgreSQL-protocol listener's own certificate. Restart required; guarded.

bolt_cert.label: Bolt TLS certificate
bolt_cert.help: A certificate file for the Bolt listener alone, instead of the shared one. Restart required; guarded.

bolt_key.label: Bolt TLS private key
bolt_key.help: The private key for the Bolt listener's own certificate. Restart required; guarded.

http_cert.label: HTTP API TLS certificate
http_cert.help: The certificate file the HTTP API presents. Restart required; guarded.

http_key.label: HTTP API TLS private key
http_key.help: The private key for the HTTP API's certificate. Restart required; guarded.

enabled.label: Result cache enabled
enabled.help: Whether query results may be cached at all. Restart required because the cache store is built at start.

default_ttl.label: Default cache lifetime
default_ttl.help: How long a cached result is kept when nothing more specific says; an organization can set its own. Restart required for the deployment default.

redis_url.label: Redis address
redis_url.help: The address of the Redis server used for caching and rate limiting; unset uses the built-in one. Secret because it can carry a password; restart required because connections are opened at start; guarded.

redis_org_password.label: Organization Redis password
redis_org_password.help: The password given to each organization's own Redis account when it is created. Secret; guarded.

redis_embedded.label: Built-in Redis
redis_embedded.help: Whether this is a desktop launch running on the built-in Redis. Set by the launcher; not editable.

ttl.label: Persisted query lifetime
ttl.help: How long a persisted query stays registered. Restart required because it is handed to the cache when it is built.

compiled_query_cache_ttl.label: Compiled query plan lifetime
compiled_query_cache_ttl.help: How long a compiled query plan is reused before it is rebuilt. Restart required because each worker reads it when it builds its cache.

enabled.label: Redirect enabled
enabled.help: The deployment's default for whether large results are written to object storage and returned as a link; an organization can set its own.

threshold.label: Redirect threshold
threshold.help: The deployment's default row count above which a result is redirected to object storage; an organization can set its own.

ttl.label: Redirect link lifetime
ttl.help: The deployment's default for how long a redirect link stays valid; an organization can set its own.

default_format.label: Redirect file format
default_format.help: The deployment's default file format for redirected results; an organization can set its own.

bucket.label: Redirect bucket
bucket.help: The object-storage bucket redirected results are written to. Guarded because changing it sends results somewhere else.

endpoint.label: Redirect object store address
endpoint.help: The address of the object store redirected results are written to. Guarded because changing it sends results somewhere else.

encrypt.label: Encrypt redirected results
encrypt.help: Whether redirected results are encrypted before they are uploaded.

local_dir.label: Redirect local folder
local_dir.help: The folder redirected results are written to when no object store can be reached.

access_key.label: Redirect access key
access_key.help: The object store's access key. Secret; guarded.

secret_key.label: Redirect secret key
secret_key.help: The object store's secret key. Secret; guarded.

trace_detail.label: Trace detail
trace_detail.help: How much detail every request's trace carries by default: normal, or debug. Restart required because it is set when tracing is configured.

trace_sql.label: SQL in traces
trace_sql.help: Whether traces carry the SQL of each stage: off, redacted (values blanked), or full. Guarded because full writes query values into traces.

trace_ast.label: Parsed statements in traces
trace_ast.help: Whether traces also carry the parsed form of each statement, with values blanked.

metric_export_interval.label: Metric export interval
metric_export_interval.help: How often metrics are exported. Restart required because it is handed to the exporter when it is built.

endpoint.label: Telemetry endpoint
endpoint.help: Where traces and metrics are sent.

protocol.label: Telemetry protocol
protocol.help: The transport the telemetry endpoint speaks: gRPC or HTTP.

service_name.label: Telemetry service name
service_name.help: The name this deployment's telemetry is reported under.

sample_rate.label: Trace sample rate
sample_rate.help: The share of requests that are traced, from 0 to 1.

log_level.label: Telemetry log level
log_level.help: The lowest severity of log record exported with telemetry.

subsystem_traces.label: Subsystem traces
subsystem_traces.help: Which internal subsystems write their own traces.

compact_cron.label: Compaction schedule
compact_cron.help: When stored telemetry files are merged into larger ones.

compact_batch_size.label: Compaction batch size
compact_batch_size.help: How many rows each merge of stored telemetry writes at a time.

compact_file_chunk.label: Compaction file chunk
compact_file_chunk.help: How many small telemetry files are read together in one merge step.

compact_max_files_per_run.label: Compaction files per run
compact_max_files_per_run.help: The most telemetry files one merge run processes.

ops_snapshot_retention_hours.label: Operational snapshot retention (hours)
ops_snapshot_retention_hours.help: How long operational snapshots are kept.

span_export_delay_millis.label: Span export delay (milliseconds)
span_export_delay_millis.help: How long spans are batched before they are exported.

otlp2parquet_max_age_secs.label: Parquet writer maximum age (seconds)
otlp2parquet_max_age_secs.help: How long the telemetry writer holds rows before writing a file.

collector_batch_timeout_ms.label: Collector batch timeout (milliseconds)
collector_batch_timeout_ms.help: How long the collector batches telemetry before forwarding it.

s3_endpoint.label: Telemetry store address
s3_endpoint.help: The object store stored telemetry is written to.

s3_bucket.label: Telemetry store bucket
s3_bucket.help: The bucket stored telemetry is written to.

s3_region.label: Telemetry store region
s3_region.help: The region of the telemetry object store.

s3_access_key.label: Telemetry store access key
s3_access_key.help: The telemetry object store's access key. Secret.

s3_secret_key.label: Telemetry store secret key
s3_secret_key.help: The telemetry object store's secret key. Secret.

support_endpoint.label: Support telemetry endpoint
support_endpoint.help: Where a copy of telemetry is sent for vendor support, when set.

support_redact_sql_literals.label: Redact SQL values for support
support_redact_sql_literals.help: Whether values in SQL are blanked in the copy sent for support.

support_redact_attributes.label: Redacted attributes for support
support_redact_attributes.help: Trace attributes removed from the copy sent for support.

tenant_url.label: Organization database address
tenant_url.help: The database that holds each organization's configuration. Not editable: the deployment needs it to find its stored settings.

platform_url.label: Platform database address
platform_url.help: The database that holds accounts, organizations and these settings. Not editable: the deployment needs it to find its stored settings.

org_id.label: Starting organization
org_id.help: The organization this deployment starts as. Not editable: it is read before stored settings can be.

pool_min.label: Minimum database connections
pool_min.help: The smallest number of control-plane database connections each worker keeps. Not editable: the pool is opened before stored settings can be read.

pool_max.label: Maximum database connections
pool_max.help: The largest number of control-plane database connections each worker opens. Not editable: the pool is opened before stored settings can be read.

config_path.label: Config file
config_path.help: The config file this deployment was started on. Not editable: it is read before stored settings can be.

data_dir.label: Data folder
data_dir.help: The folder the deployment keeps its files in. Not editable: it is read before stored settings can be.

home.label: Home folder
home.help: The deployment's home folder for certificates and local stores. Not editable: it is read before stored settings can be.

repo_dir.label: Configuration history folder
repo_dir.help: The folder that holds each organization's configuration history. Not editable: it is read before stored settings can be.

demo.label: Demo mode
demo.help: Whether the deployment was started in demo mode. Set by the launcher; not editable.

max_rows.label: MCP row limit
max_rows.help: The most rows one MCP tool call returns to an AI client.

port.label: MCP port
port.help: The port the MCP server listens on; 0 leaves it off. Restart required; guarded because it opens or closes a listener.

host.label: MCP host
host.help: The network address the MCP server binds; 127.0.0.1 keeps it to this machine. Restart required; guarded because it decides who can reach the port.

tls.label: MCP TLS
tls.help: Whether the MCP server serves HTTPS. Restart required; guarded.

role.label: MCP local role
role.help: The role local (stdio) MCP calls run as; until it is set those calls are refused. Guarded because it grants that role's access to anyone who can start the local client.

external_url.label: MCP external address
external_url.help: The MCP address shown to users when the deployment sits behind a proxy.

chat_model.label: Chat model
chat_model.help: The model the built-in chat uses, overriding each organization's own choice.

egress_allowlist.label: Hosted function egress allowlist
egress_allowlist.help: The hosts a hosted function may call out to; everything else is refused. Guarded because each entry opens an outbound path.

consumer_group_id.label: CDC consumer group
consumer_group_id.help: The name this deployment uses when it reads change events from a message broker.

max_object_depth.label: Remote GraphQL object depth
max_object_depth.help: How deep nested objects from a remote GraphQL source are followed.

max_list_depth.label: Remote GraphQL list depth
max_list_depth.help: How deep nested lists from a remote GraphQL source are followed.

max_list_items.label: Remote GraphQL list items
max_list_items.help: The most items read from one list of a remote GraphQL source.

max_rows.label: Remote GraphQL rows per read
max_rows.help: The most rows one read of a paged remote GraphQL table takes.

engine_namespace.label: Engine namespace
engine_namespace.help: The Kubernetes namespace engine clusters are created in.

engine_cluster_mode.label: Engine cluster mode
engine_cluster_mode.help: The kind of Kubernetes cluster engines are provisioned on.

engine_cpu.label: Engine CPU
engine_cpu.help: The CPU given to each provisioned engine.

engine_shard.label: Engine shard
engine_shard.help: The engine shard this node belongs to.

engine_otlp_endpoint.label: Engine telemetry endpoint
engine_otlp_endpoint.help: Where provisioned engines send their own telemetry.

engine_control_plane_host.label: Engine control-plane host
engine_control_plane_host.help: The address engines use to reach the control-plane database, when it differs from the one this server uses.

engine_control_plane_port.label: Engine control-plane port
engine_control_plane_port.help: The port engines use to reach the control-plane database.

engine_lakehouse_metastore_host.label: Lakehouse metastore host
engine_lakehouse_metastore_host.help: The address of the lakehouse metastore engines use.

engine_lakehouse_metastore_port.label: Lakehouse metastore port
engine_lakehouse_metastore_port.help: The port of the lakehouse metastore engines use.

engine_otel_s3_endpoint.label: Engine telemetry store address
engine_otel_s3_endpoint.help: The telemetry object store's address as engines reach it.

isolated_engine_image.label: Dedicated engine image
isolated_engine_image.help: The container image used for an organization's dedicated engine.

isolated_engine_network.label: Dedicated engine network
isolated_engine_network.help: The container network a dedicated engine is attached to.

isolated_engine_memory.label: Dedicated engine memory
isolated_engine_memory.help: The memory given to a dedicated engine.

isolated_engine_host_template.label: Dedicated engine host pattern
isolated_engine_host_template.help: The pattern a dedicated engine's host name is built from.

isolated_engine_port.label: Dedicated engine port
isolated_engine_port.help: The port a dedicated engine listens on.

isolated_engine_ready_timeout.label: Dedicated engine ready timeout
isolated_engine_ready_timeout.help: How long to wait for a dedicated engine to become ready.

isolated_engine_docker_socket.label: Dedicated engine Docker socket
isolated_engine_docker_socket.help: The Docker socket used to start dedicated engines.

zaychik_cpu.label: Query gateway CPU
zaychik_cpu.help: The CPU given to the engine's query gateway.

zaychik_memory.label: Query gateway memory
zaychik_memory.help: The memory given to the engine's query gateway.

readonlyReasons.locates_control_plane: This setting tells the server where its control plane is, so it cannot be changed from the control plane.
readonlyReasons.read_before_control_plane: This setting is read before the control plane is available, so it is set outside the UI.
readonlyReasons.set_by_launcher: The launcher that started this deployment sets this value.
readonlyReasons.set_by_desktop_launcher: The desktop launcher sets this value for this installation.
